# Banana Detail

> Mobile car detailing. Interior and exterior details, carried out by hand at the
> customer's home or workplace.

Based in Bradford, Ontario. Serves Bradford, Innisfil, East Gwillimbury, Newmarket,
King Township and New Tecumseth.
Phone: (647) 829-2242 — call or text for a quote.

Services and starting prices (CAD):
- Express Wash & Wax — $60
- Interior Detail — $150
- Exterior Detail — $140
- Full Detail, inside and out — $199
- Engine Bay Cleaning — $70
- Headlight Restoration — $80
- Pet Hair & Odour Removal — $60

Size adjustments (apply to Express, Exterior, Interior and Full Detail): SUV +$30;
large SUV / 3-row / truck / van +$50. Prices above are for a sedan/coupe.
Engine Bay Cleaning is $50 when added to any detail, $70 standalone.
Light pet hair is included in Interior Detail and Full Detail; heavy pet hair / odour
treatment is the $60 service above.

Final prices depend on vehicle size and condition and are agreed before work begins.

Booking: the customer sends photos, receives a price and a time, then confirms through a
link that carries the booking details and the service terms. No deposit. Payment is due
on completion.
